description: One worker by its handle (S64 T3) — the door the CLI follows a graph.build through and the app reads the finished BuildReport from: the result column travels as raw JSON so the runner's own accounting (files, nodes, edges, unresolvedEdges) arrives exactly as written, no second rendering of it anywhere. `started` never appears on a View: it said whether YOUR call began the pass, and it lives in graph.build's answer instead.
